recent.text: A league source confirms to Orlando Magic Daily that the #Magic and Kevin Porter Jr. are working toward finalizing a deal. Porter averaged 17.4 PPG and 7.4 APG in 38 games with the Bucks last year. https://t.co/uJ44a8mb9F
recent.author: Orlando Magic Daily

recent.text: The #Magic are getting the scoring help they need. Kevin Porter Jr. is an excellent scorer to say the least. We will see how much it will help in the end.
recent.author: Orlando Magic Daily
recent.quoted_text: Free agent guard Kevin Porter Jr. is finalizing a two-year contract to sign with the Orlando Magic, Sam Permut of Roc Nation tells ESPN. https://t.co/72BK05wjXG

recent.text: My @orlandosports recap as the #Magic drop a key NBA Cup game to the Pistons: “The main one was turnovers,” Sean Sweeney said when asked what led to Orlando’s issues vs. Detroit. “In the second quarter, we had a lot of turnovers.” https://t.co/OKzIURkwzT
recent.author: Jason Beede

recent.text: I asked Tristan da Silva about Orlando’s 11 second-quarter turnovers vs. Detroit and he mentioned the #Magic were playing into a crowd in that stretch: “Detroit did a great job of packing the paint and being aggressive on the ball when it (was) driven,” da Silva said. More: https://t.co/EB3a5IDJc2
recent.author: Jason Beede

recent.text: Anthony Black is unplayable if he is not going to shoot that. You have to make quick decisions against this #Pistons defense. They are feeding off the #Magic's doubt. DET 75:63 ORL 10:33 4th
recent.author: Orlando Magic Daily

recent.text: Desmond Bane is really picking up his defensive energy Diving headfirst for the ball on several occasions. #Magic are trying to find a spark. They definitely still have time here against this #Pistons team. Margin for error is shrinking. DET 67:56 ORL 2:49 3rd

recent.text: The #Magic have mostly responded since the slow start. They are 3 for 7 from three with Tristan da Silva hitting two threes. Shooting covers for a lot of mistakes. Still unsettled defensively. And they have no plan when they attack Ausar. DET 12:13 ORL 5:07 1st

recent.text: The #Magic are starting Jalen Suggs, Desmond Bane, Anthony Black, Franz Wagner and Wendell Carter Jr. for tonight’s NBA Cup game against the Pistons.
recent.author: Jason Beede

recent.text: My latest for @orlandosports: #Magic’s Anthony Black aims to play with more force, improve at free throw line: “… I’m not going to the rim with the right intent. So, he’s telling me to be more aggressive…,” Black said about coach Sean Sweeney. More: https://t.co/2k18F10iaW
recent.author: Jason Beede
